newsitem.title: USA: Great Southern Bancorp explains net gains.
newsitem.headline: Great Southern Bancorp explains net gains.

text.p: Great Southern Bancorp Inc said Wednesday strong net interest margin, gains in non-interest income and continued cost controls helped second quarter profits climb by 17.4 percent.

The bank holding company said second-quarter net income reached $2.9 million, or $0.34 a share, compared with $2.5 million, or $0.27 a share, one year ago. Total assets as of December 31 were $669 million, compared to $659 million one year ago.
Great Southern Bancorp is the parent of Great Southern Bank. Its shares were trading down 3/4 Wednesday at 17-1/4.
